version.changelog: Make public skill package instruction-only for install-gate PASS and move helper scripts to companion repo path.

llm.summary: This skill is a coherent Chrome extension release-check workflow with no embedded executable payload or hidden persistence, though it depends on separately supplied companion scripts.

dimensions.detail: GitHub CLI, local test tooling, Chrome release checks, and competitor checks are proportionate for extension release preparation, but users should expect local repo inspection and possible authenticated GitHub tooling.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact itself is instruction-only and ships no executable scripts; install metadata asks for git, gh, npx, and python, and optionally brew-installs GitHub CLI. Companion scripts must be supplied separately via OPENCLAW_CWS_PUBLISHER_DIR.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill tells the agent to operate on the user-named repo and exact upload ZIP, but it does include repo-wide tracked and untracked non-ignored leak scanning within that target repo.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No artifact evidence shows background workers, startup hooks, memory writes, credential harvesting, privilege escalation, or automatic publishing; it renders publish commands rather than silently submitting releases.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The instructions align with packaging, validating, leak-checking, testing, and preparing metadata for Chrome Web Store and related GitHub/ClawHub release workflows.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before using it, confirm the target repo path and ZIP are the ones you intend to release, review any companion scripts you point OPENCLAW_CWS_PUBLISHER_DIR at, and be aware that leak scans may inspect tracked and untracked non-ignored files in that repo.
